titleText: JTF News: Government of Canada, CBC News
mainText: Canada will provide $5 million for humanitarian aid to Venezuela following earthquakes.

titleText: JTF News: Deutsche Welle, ABC News Australia
mainText: UK Navy reports a cargo vessel was hit in the Strait of Hormuz.
The U.S. Supreme Court ruled in favor of Bayer in Roundup-related cancer lawsuits.
Two earthquakes in Venezuela resulted in at least 164 deaths, and President Trump canceled a housing bill signing.
The U.S. Supreme Court ruled to allow President Trump to end protected status for Haitian and Syrian immigrants.
